# dw from the middle of a word deletes to the start of the next
text:  foo b‸ar baz
keys:  dw
want:  foo b‸baz
reg:   " c ar␠

# a count on both sides multiplies
text:  ‸a b c d e f g
keys:  2d2w
want:  ‸e f g

# cw on a word acts as ce: the space after it stays
text:  ‸foo bar
keys:  cwX<Esc>
want:  ‸X bar

# dw on the last word of a line does not join the next line
text:
    foo ‸bar
    baz
keys:  dw
want:
    foo‸␠
    baz

# x at the end of the line steps the cursor back
text:  ab‸c
keys:  x
want:  a‸b
reg:   " c c

# ciw on whitespace changes the whitespace (vim's rule)
text:  foo ‸   bar
keys:  ciwX<Esc>
want:  foo‸Xbar

# Y yanks to the end of the line: nvim's default, not vim's
text:  foo ‸bar
keys:  Y
want:  foo ‸bar
reg:   " c bar
